scope: include/wabt, binary reader/validator/interpreter, wasm2c C writer/CLI/templates, and regular-memory wasm2c C runtime; selected sources are listed in scripts/build_cxx.py. No WAST parser, WASI or other OS source code

local_changes.src/common.cc: Native n_stat/N_FT_DIR instead of a POSIX stat structure
local_changes.include/wabt/interp/interp.h: Store interrupt callback, Memory/Table/Global change observers, reference-stable dynamic call frames, native fallible Memory/Table storage
local_changes.include/wabt/interp/interp-inl.h: Memory/Table allocation failures return empty references; Global change notification
local_changes.src/interp/interp.cc: Poll existing execution batches, notify memory and reference changes, fallible native memory/table growth, dynamic reference-stable call frames
local_changes.src/binary-reader.cc: Poll cancellation at section/function boundaries without per-byte clock syscalls
local_changes.src/sha256.cc: Use the existing Nocturne BearSSL SHA-256 implementation
local_changes.src/c-writer.cc: Native locale handling and browser-owned embedded C translation
local_changes.wasm2c/wasm-rt.h: Native target profile, explicit bounds checks, native thread state and trap boundary
local_changes.wasm2c/wasm-rt-impl.c: Native thread initialization, stack boundary checking and cancellation trap
local_changes.src/template/wasm2c.declarations.c: Native stack and cancellation checks; regenerated by the original CMake template generator

reproduction: The vendored source is authoritative for builds. Compare its listed local changes against the pinned git revision; vendor-wabt imports missing upstream files but does not overwrite reviewed local modifications.
